thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: elevated 5xx rate for /v1/generate in us-east-1 — 3min avg 11.8% (baseline 0.2%). Alert triggered at 1918248642.

sre-oncall-1: acked, joining bridge. investigating error traces now. @vikram @lena please standby.

vikram: I see spike correlating with recent config push at ~1918248200 — feature flag 'model-routing-v2' rolled to 50% for us-east. Could be a mismatch between control plane and dataplane.

lena: oncall aware. pulling live logs from edge and control plane. prod-support, any customer reports?

prod-support: 3 customers on Dedicated reported latency + failures in the last 10m — tickets linked: https://tickets.example/INC-3821, INC-3823. severity P2.

alex: copying logs, sharing tail.

alex: ```
[2029-07-12T12:04:21.123Z] ERROR route-handler: upstream call failed status=502 model=redwood-v1 shard=dp-09
[2029-07-12T12:04:22.001Z] WARN  routing: requested model variant=redwood-v2 but fallback used=redwood-v1
[2029-07-12T12:05:02.345Z] ERROR kv-cache: invalid kv token on connection id=xyz
```

maria: interesting — control plane shows flag as ON for v2 at 50%, but dataplane config still shows routing table pointing to redwood-v1 on many nodes. sending command to refresh config and forcing propagation to dp-07..dp-12.

eng-runtime: hold on — forcing propagation may cause a flurry of restarts. what's the customer impact if we do a quick rollback?

vikram: hypothesis A: race during feature flag rollout + partial config propagation caused some dataplane nodes to serve mismatched model binaries (v2 routing to v1 binaries) causing 502s and cache misses. Hypothesis B: quantization variant mismatch on v2 causing runtime kernel failures on some GPUs. Both could explain 502s but we see explicit fallback logs.

sre-oncall-1: good hypotheses. Need to gather timeline. @ops-bot can you attach autoscaling events + deployment events from 1918247000..1918249200?

ops-bot: attached: deployment_event: 1918248120 "push model-routing flag v2 -> 50%"; config_refresh: 1918248150 cluster-controlplane -> issued; config_apply_ack: partial: nodes [dp-01..dp-06] acknowledged at 1918248180; nodes [dp-07..dp-12] no ack. autoscaler: no scale events in window.

lena: so partial ack. That lines up. We probably have a propagation gap. Next steps: 1) stop rollout (set flag back to 0% or to safe route), 2) force-sync dataplane configs, or 3) fallback rule to route traffic to a stable model variant. We should pick minimal blast radius.

maria: recommendation: set flag to 0% for us-east immediately to stop new v2 routing decisions, then force sync on the odd nodes. I'm worried about in-flight requests state.

eng-runtime: if we set flag to 0% the control plane will instruct new requests to prefer v1, but nodes with stale config may still route incorrectly until they refresh. Forcing a config sync involves sending SIGHUP to the agent or calling /admin/refresh which shouldn't restart model servers. prefer that.

sre-oncall-1: do it. maria, please run the control-plane rollback. alex, trigger /admin/refresh on dp-07..dp-12. track rates.

maria: rolling flag back now. command: ```curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/flags/model-routing-v2 -d '{"percent":0}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'```

maria: done at 1918248775. control plane reports flag=0% globally.

alex: starting refresh on dp-07..dp-12:```for node in dp-07 dp-08 dp-09 dp-10 dp-11 dp-12; do curl -s -X POST http://$node:8080/admin/refresh || echo failed:$node; done```

alex: refresh results: dp-07 ok, dp-08 ok, dp-09 failed (connection reset), dp-10 ok, dp-11 ok, dp-12 ok. retrying dp-09.

eng-runtime: dp-09 showing GPU OOM logs earlier at 12:03:58 — might be unrelated but could explain failure to apply. grabbing node logs.

alex: dp-09 logs: ```
[12:03:58] WARN  gpu-manager: evicting model redwood-v2 due to memory pressure
[12:03:59] ERROR agent: failed to apply routing table: service unavailable
```

sre-oncall-1: traffic graph updated — 5xx rate dropping to 3% at 1918248900. still above baseline but trending down.

prod-support: updating customers that we're mitigating, ETA 30m for full recovery. sending note now.

maria: forced refresh retried on dp-09 succeeded at 1918248925. confirmation ack from node. routing table now consistent.

ops-bot: monitoring note: 5xx back to baseline 0.4% at 1918249050.

vikram: recapping hypotheses: primary cause = rollout + partial propagation (propagation race). secondary cause = resource pressure on dp-09 causing failure to apply config, which extended the inconsistency window. quantization/kernel mismatch unlikely given logs show fallbacks and eviction, not model runtime crashes. mark primary.

lena: capturing timeline for RCA: 1918248120 flag -> 50% rollout; 1918248150 control plane issued refresh; 1918248180 nodes dp-01..06 ack; 1918248200 onwards errors start; 1918248642 alert; 1918248775 rollback; 1918248925 dp-09 refresh ack; 1918249050 errors baseline.

eng-runtime: quick mitigation notes for RCA: add check to abort rollout if >X% nodes don't ack within Y seconds; add agent-level backoff/retry for config apply and better surfacing of failures to control plane. also add a safe-fallback guard in routing to avoid mixing variants mid-request.

sre-oncall-1: handing off to next oncall @vikram for post-incident follow-up and RCA writeup. I'm staying on for 10m to help with notes.

vikram: taking. will own RCA doc and follow up with eng-runtime and prod-support for action items. can someone drop the list of affected customers and request ids here?

prod-support: affected: CustA (dedicated-us-east), CustB (saas, us-east), CustC (dedicated-us-east). support tickets: INC-3821, INC-3823, INC-3824. all updated.

maria: a few action items I recorded: (1) block-rollout-if-partial-ack (P1), (2) agent-config-apply-retries (P2), (3) alert-tune-for-partial-propagation (P3). I'll create JIRA and link to RCA.

ops-bot: bridge closed at 1918249210. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall-1: thanks team — leaving notes in incident tracker. :thumbsup:
